Expensive dining but felt like a fast food experience
Jun 2025 • Solo
My last night in Hanoi, wanted to treat myself to something fancy, spoil myself for my last night and found Moca Dining, I thought perfect, mix of traditional and international, looked at the menu and booked online.

Arrived, greeted by the girl at the door, asked for my reservation name, then said “oh, your alone” I replied why what did I make the booking for, she said 1 Person, I said well then that’s correct. 

Ordered the bone marrow for my appetiser and the ribeye steak for my main, got complementary bread and a little salad thing, my starter came and I literally took the last bite and they took the plate of me and served me my main….. 

I said to the waitress, I wasn’t ready for my
Main just yet, I was literally still chewing my appetizer and she just laughed and said oh well the chef cooked it. 

So within 24 minutes, I’ve had my entire meal and still have a full drink, the place is empty, not sure what the rush is.

The bone marrow was delicious, can’t comment on the steak as I could still taste the bone marrow and it was getting cold so I had to eat it quickly, was fairly thin for a ribeye.

Prices are expensive and for what I am paying I absolutely did not have the experience at all, contemplated complaining to the manager as it put a dampener to the end of my trip but had a feeling they wouldn’t care so I decided not to.

I’d advise, order your starter and when that’s finished then order your main.

The waiter took my plate, didn’t ask me if I enjoyed it or not and just said do you want desert, I declined.

Wouldn’t come again

Overall experience would lend to a four star.
